name: Chemdawg 4
summary: Chemdawg 4 is a [[kind:cut|cut]] from one of the last original [[chemdawg|Chemdawg]] seeds, four of which Chemdog gave to the grower Joe Brand in 2006. Brand kept the fourth plant, known as the Reunion Pheno. It is a sibling of Chem 91 and a parent of Gorilla Glue #4.

sources.title: 25 Years of Chem Dog
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms that Chemdog gave four of his last six seeds to Joe Brand in 2006, who picked Chem #4 as the Reunion Pheno.

sources.title: Chemdawg 4 Strain
sources.note: Gives 63–77 days of flowering and the Gorilla Glue #4 connection.
